title: aiggp.session/v1 - one session manifest, both sides
description: The single statement of shape for a work-session (an agent opening a game repo to edit) and a play-session (the runtime booting a run). Validated by scripts/game_session_start.py with the same Draft-07 subset rules_check.py uses (type, enum, pattern, required, properties, additionalProperties:false, items, minLength, minItems, $ref). Two rules are NOT expressible here and are named in the spec and enforced by the brain: (1) `capture` present implies a non-empty `stream_id` (the static `required` below already refuses the present case; the brain keeps the explicit check because the design names it); (2) `kind: play` under `determinism.enabled: true` requires a non-empty `seed`, which depends on the PROJECT's game-manifest.json, not on this document. A reader of this schema alone must never think validation is complete.
